compare.P2: offsets fitted on training out-of-fold risks (22,998 patients)

A_group_offsets.measure_on_V2: observed / expected (24 h) per insurance and ethnicity level; mean |log O/E| over levels with >= 20 V2 events

compare.P3: parity thresholds learned on V1 (alert-budget-v1 method, with P1 offsets)
compare.P4: parity thresholds learned on training out-of-fold risks (with P2 offsets); the detection target is certified against the budget on V1

B_small_group_thresholds.reference: P0 with the certified single threshold (M1)
B_small_group_thresholds.measure_on_V2: false alerts per patient-day, budget met, overall detection, detection per ethnicity group, detection range across groups and lowest group detection

C_sample_splitting.setting: system shift with the system-shift-v1 cross-system models, target-system validation patients only

compare.double_use: group recalibration and certified threshold both fitted on all local fitting patients
compare.split: recalibration on one half of the local fitting patients, certified threshold on the other half

C_sample_splitting.measure: coverage = share of repeats whose evaluation-patient false-alert rate is within budget; detection

config.adoption_rule: A fix is carried into a new prespecified test evaluation only if it improves its measure on V2 averaged over the splits (A: lower mean |log O/E| than P1; B: smaller detection range and no lower worst-group detection than P0, with the budget met; C: coverage >= 95% where double use is below 95%). Otherwise it is reported as not helpful.

specification.registration: immutable local record; not public preregistration
